metadata.description: Example B SCD Assignment: sets slot, budget, subdivision, and the upper power set point. The set point of 1800 W sits below the 2000 W budget, which is the relation the OAC checks -- a value above the budget would be refused with code 0x10. Omits ocp.initial_power_min_w because the declared 625 W floor suits this platform, and omits pen.32473.boot_source because this controller does not recognize PEN 32473 -- the OAC applies local_flash regardless. Both omissions are legitimate even though boot_source is classified required; the class describes the value, it does not oblige the Assignment.
